Union Suite · WIP prototype · display only

Task rows

Each scenario below is rendered twice at the same width: Current, the older two-line .us-task row, and Accepted, the format now used for new lists (us-task--detail). Both come from the canonical Query Templates and the shipped theme CSS and behaviour — this page adds page chrome and the controls only, and no styles of its own.

The accepted row changes shape with the width of the list, not the window, because the same page can hold a 600px homepage panel and a 1150px tasks page. The width buttons are the sizes the list is actually used at.

No tenant is touched. Ticking a task runs the real completion sequence, including the PUT to i4u_UT_Interactions, but this page answers that request itself. Turn on Simulate save failure to see a rejected write: the row comes back with its original state and says so. Reset rows restores anything completed.

Width

Supported author recipes, field definitions and iPart settings live in the usage guide and references/List-Templates.html. The accepted row is Tasks-Detail-Query-Template.html with the US-TASK-ROWS styles in zUnionSuite.css; prototypes/approved/task-rows/ records the decisions behind it.
